lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity local maxima are distributed in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill region. Centroids are aligned in roughly five horizontal rows between the pectoral fin and the dorsal fin region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with horizontal spot rows. Intersections are marked by high-intensity circular clusters, particularly prominent in the area between the fifth gill slit and the first dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features exhibit a high-contrast luminance gradient along the dorsal-lateral surface, characterized by bright upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance circular blobs. Point density is higher at the anterior base and decreases towards the posterior tip.
